text:
Marta Rivera: Heads up — planning a slow canary for payment-service v2.3 on Monday at 19:00 PT. Goal: validate latency and error profile before full flip. I need a deploy owner and smoke lead.
Li Chen: I can own the deploy and the rollout steps. Will be on-call for the window.
Samir Patel: I'll own monitoring — dashboards and alerts. I'll pin the latency and 5xx graphs.
DeployBot: Scheduled: payment-service v2.3 deploy job #DJ-8147 -> window 2025-06-02T02:00:00Z (19:00 PT). Auto-rollback disabled (manual).
Jorge Alvarez: Cohort split? Percentages and regions?
Marta Rivera: Proposed ramp: 0.5% (internal/beta) -> 2% (US small) -> 10% (US + EU small) -> 25% (global limited). Intervals: 10m / 10m / 30m between steps, with manual hold if any signal spikes.
Tara O'Neill: Where do we gate the 10% step? Which signal threshold?
Samir Patel: Gate: 5xx rate delta > 0.3% absolute OR p95 latency increase > 40ms for the cohort for 5m => hold and investigate. Also monitor error-rate by endpoint and payment provider.
Li Chen: Smoke checklist I'll run during the first 0.5%: create 20 synthetic transactions, 5 refund flows, and 3 provider-edge failure injections.
Marta Rivera: Good. Also validate KV cache warming and prefix cache isn't returning stale tokens.
Samir Patel: Quick commands I'll run from my laptop:

```
# smoke quick checks
curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/payment -H "x-canary: true" -d '{"amount":1}'
redwood check health payment-service --window=2m
monitor-cli query "service:payment-service AND env:canary" --panel latency,errors
```

Jorge Alvarez: Who has access to toggle cohorts? I need to flip the cohort gating if we need to scale the sample.
Marta Rivera: Ops & me have toggles. @Jorge I'll add you to the "canary-toggleers" group tonight.
Tara O'Neill: Rollback plan spelled out? Automated or manual?
Li Chen: Manual rollback: run `redwood rollback payment-service v2.2 --force` (this pins traffic to v2.2). If automated fallback needed, we have a simple nginx route-level fallback to v2.2 for new sessions.
Samir Patel: I'll have the runbook open and a slack loop for escalation. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/payment-canary (contains exact metrics, playbook, and contact list).
Marta Rivera: One more ops detail: we will disable the feature flag for fraud-beta if any degradation. Flag path: flags/payment/fraud-beta.
DeployBot: Reminder: deploy job #DJ-8147 will notify channel at each step. Manual ACK required to proceed between 2% -> 10%.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll be on the first hold and ready to flip the flag.
Tara O'Neill: I'll run the refund smoke and verify downstream ledger reconciliation.
Samir Patel: I'll be watching from 18:45 PT and will call hold if thresholds breach.
Li Chen: All set from infra side. I'll post the exact start message 5m before the deploy and tag owners.
Marta Rivera: Perfect — thanks team. @Li please call out if any infra queuing or cold-starts show up during the 0.5% step. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: ACK :eyes:
Tara O'Neill: ACK :thumbsup:
Jorge Alvarez: ACK :rocket:
